authors: U. Ghia, K. N. Ghia, C. T. Shin

conditions.geometry: unit square cavity, lid moving in +x at unit speed, no-slip walls
conditions.normalisation: u/U_lid on x/L = 0.5, v/U_lid on y/L = 0.5

cross_check: Re = 100 u column and the v column agree with a second, independent public transcription (sites.google.com/view/sidrg ... lid-driven-cavity-flow), 2026-09-26
kind_note: a NUMERICAL benchmark (multigrid finite-difference solution, 129 x 129 grid), not an experiment
license_status: the tabulated numbers of one Reynolds number (17 points per line) are quoted with full attribution; the paper and the transcription files are NOT copied
publication: Journal of Computational Physics 48(3), 387-411 (1982), Tables I and II, Re = 100 column
title: High-Re solutions for incompressible flow using the Navier-Stokes equations and a multigrid method
transcription_caveat: the same transcriptions carry obvious typographical errors in OTHER Reynolds-number columns (e.g. Re=3200 at y=0.4531); only the Re=100 columns are used here
